name: National Structural Code of the Philippines (NSCP 2015, Volume 1)
description: The National Structural Code of the Philippines 2015, Volume 1 (alpha 9 track C16), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22: Section 208 earthquake loads in the UBC 1997 form (seismic zones 2 and 4 with Z 0.20 and 0.40, soil profiles SA-SF, seismic coefficients Ca and Cv, near-source factors Na and Nv from the seismic source type and distance, V = Cv I W / R T within 2.5 Ca I W / R, 0.11 Ca I W and 0.8 Z Nv I W / R, R and Ω0, the period Ct hn^(3/4), the storey drift, the importance factors of Table 208-1), Section 207 wind in the ASCE 7-10 form (the basic wind speed of each province, the ASCE 7-10 velocity pressure constants), Chapter 4 structural concrete (ACI 318-14 numbered 4xx: the clause references in that numbering, the base pack's ACI 318-19 rules, PNS 49 bar sizes) and Chapter 5 steel (AISC 360, the base pack's). Combinations and live loads are the base pack's (ASCE 7-22, the same form as NSCP 2015 Sec 203 and 205 for the cases SAEngine builds). Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the province wind speeds are uncertain and must be checked before design.

sources.title: National Structural Code of the Philippines, Volume 1: Buildings, Towers and Other Vertical Structures (NSCP 2015)

basis.general: NSCP 2015 Chapter 2 (with ASCE 7-22 where it gives the same rule)
basis.concrete: NSCP 2015 Chapter 4 (ACI 318-19 rules of the base pack)
basis.steel: NSCP 2015 Chapter 5 (AISC 360-22 rules of the base pack)
